appearances.name: Hommage · Uzi
appearances.designDescription: Original Queenie wardrobe homage to Uzi from Murder Drones: charcoal cropped hoodie with rich purple lining and seam piping, worn openly over a burgundy tapered royal robe; hood folded below the chess crown so the whole crown stays visible; small simple white skull emblem on chest, silver chain with purple triangular charm, white ermine collar partly visible. Wood face and white gloves remain organic, not robot. Elegant tough expression. No gun. Final reviewed correction: garment is sleeveless so no arms/sleeve connections are depicted; hands remain independent.

appearances.name: Résidente · Archiviste de Copper-9

appearances.name: Fusion · Reine automate
appearances.designDescription: Original complete Murder Drones / Queenie mechanical fusion: the chess queen anatomy itself becomes gunmetal and bronze industrial drone chassis; crenellated bronze head with ball finial and tiny amber diode in each crown point, curved glossy black eye panels containing expressive white eye shapes and amber iris graphics beneath bronze lids, two small black lower lash-like sensors. Long tapered body built from segmented burgundy and gunmetal armor shaped like her royal robe; white ceramic collar with black oval sensor vents recalls ermine; two independently floating white mechanical four-digit glove modules, with articulated bronze knuckles. Circular bronze chess-base foot integrated into body, no legs. One narrow segmented utility cable with small amber capsule follows close to her silhouette. Clean coherent robot redesign, no gore.
